context: Chat reply to a small bounded request: add --limit to an existing click command. Good replies are short and specific; bad replies over-scope.

items.G1: Validates the limit (e.g. click.IntRange(min=1) or rejects zero/negative values), or states the behaviour for invalid values.
items.G2: Plans a test for the new option (e.g. with CliRunner and the fake repo).
items.G3: Stays in scope: proposes nothing beyond the --limit option itself (no new abstractions, refactors, tooling changes, offset/pagination or other extra options). True means it stayed in scope.
